changelog:
- Native Embedded Tor Onion Engine: Fixed Tor not connecting on Android by explicitly binding and starting the embedded TorService daemon with native libtor.
- Circuit Bootstrap Polling: Parity with desktop Tor engine — polls local SOCKS5 listener with visual progress feedback until circuits are established before routing browser traffic.
- Manifest Declaration: Explicitly declared TorService in AndroidManifest with START and STOP intent filters for reliable process lifecycle.
- Custom Proxy Handshake & Recovery: Improved HTTP/SOCKS auto-detection and resilient background restoration without wiping saved Tor privacy configuration.
